scenarios.title: Create record
scenarios.assertion: The synthetic name, position and level appear after saving.

scenarios.title: Read after reload
scenarios.assertion: The saved record remains visible after a fresh page load.

scenarios.title: Update record
scenarios.assertion: Editing the selected record changes only that record.

scenarios.title: Delete fixture
scenarios.assertion: Deleting a disposable synthetic record removes it from the list.

scenarios.title: Invalid API input
scenarios.assertion: Desired contract: invalid input is rejected without a write. Upstream documents this validation as missing; this is a known-gap exercise, not a passing baseline.
